preconditions.description: The input is a single line containing a positive integer A, where 1 ≤ A ≤ 10¹².

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().isdigit() and int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for x in range(1, A + 1) if sum(all_divisors(x)) == A)
postconditions.description: The output is the count of distinct positive integers x such that the sum of all positive divisors of x (including 1 and x itself) equals A. The function all_divisors(x) returns the sorted list of all positive divisors of x.
